committees.name: South Northamptonshire Local Area Planning Committee

committee_papers.note: Committee ids from the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26; none of these is flagged expired there. Check the meeting dates to pick the committee in force at the decision date. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: YYYY/NNNN/TYPE, one numbering series across the whole council area. The detail page takes the reference in path form: /Planning/Display/2026/3827/ADV.

browser_route.note: Reference with its slashes, e.g. /Planning/Display/2026/3827/ADV. Accept the disclaimer when asked.

quirks.summary: One register covers the whole unitary, including the former Daventry, Northampton and South Northamptonshire areas.
quirks.detail: The council's 'view and comment on a planning application' page links only this register. PlanIt no longer holds a planning area for Daventry (planning_url null). The test application (2026/3827/ADV) was in Brackley, in the former South Northamptonshire area. Pre-2021 legacy-district cases were not checked on this register.
quirks.workaround: Search here for any current West Northamptonshire reference; for a pre-2021 district reference, confirm it is on this register before concluding it is missing.

quirks.summary: Every page first redirects to /Disclaimer?returnUrl=...; accept with an empty POST to /Disclaimer/Accept?returnUrl=<path> sending Content-Length: 0.
quirks.detail: The form carries no anti-forgery token. The 302 sets an AcceptedDisclaimer cookie whose value is the UK local time and whose expires attribute is the same instant in GMT, so a client that enforces cookie expiry strictly may treat it as expired at once. A cookie jar that kept it worked for the detail page and download.
quirks.workaround: Accept once at the start and keep the jar; if a later call returns the disclaimer page, accept again.

quirks.summary: Detail links are path-form (/Planning/Display/<REF with slashes>), and the documents page lists every link twice.
quirks.workaround: Match both detail-link forms and de-duplicate the /Document/Download links before counting (26 hrefs = 13 documents on the test case).

pacing.note: Six requests to the register host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge. The host is behind Cloudflare (passive at the time).

robots.note: No robots.txt (404). The disclaimer's terms cover liability, copyright and data protection; they do not prohibit automated access.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the register; fingerprinted as classic DEF Atrium. Disclaimer accepted by an empty POST (Content-Length: 0). Reference 2026/3827/ADV from PlanIt's applics records -> /Planning/Display/2026/3827/ADV -> 13 distinct /Document/Download links (PlanIt n_documents 13) -> downloaded the site location plan with the jar: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 862,826 bytes, one page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. The council's planning page and PlanIt's areas list were checked for legacy-area routing: one register. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for committee ids.
